brief: Fix browser live panel viewport+input; deploy to UAT; live-validate side panel AND pop-out fullscreen

goals.title: F1 reshape
goals.objective: SetViewport reshapes the real tab via Browser.setWindowBounds; setDeviceMetricsOverride only for DPR
goals.evidence: live.go SetViewport: SetWindowBounds + dsf-only override + getLayoutMetrics read-back logged/cached; go build/vet clean; TestRescaleInputCoords PASS (agent report)

goals.title: F2 resolution
goals.objective: encoder keeps resolution (maintain-resolution, scaleResolutionDownBy 1, higher bitrate)
goals.evidence: encoder.js maintain-resolution + scaleResolutionDownBy=1 + 6Mbps; node --check OK (agent report)

goals.title: F3 input mapping
goals.objective: pointer/keyboard mapping correct when capture size != page CSS pixels

goals.title: UAT side panel
goals.objective: deploy; live-measure stream aspect==panel aspect, size~panel CSSxDPR, click activates target in side panel

goals.title: UAT pop-out
goals.objective: same live validation in pop-out new-tab fullscreen mode
